text: no cue: one minute in, on a wash at shaft power near sustainable; let the start settle before judging

arguments.message: pod reserve below 40 pct while still on a wash: decide hang on or let go
pod reserve below 20 pct with more than 800 m to go

text: no cue: over-pace alert came from the boat model, which the wash inflates; pod effort is only slightly above sustainable and the wash is worth keeping for now; added pod-based watches for the let-go decision
no cue: holding the pack wash at shaft power below critical power with the pod reserve near 90 pct; boat reserve at zero is a wash artefact

arguments.text: Plenty in reserve. Lift your effort a notch and hold it.

text: push: off the wash, shaft power 142 W is well below critical power 151 W and the sustainable 160 W, pod reserve 90 pct
no cue: push cue given about 35 s ago, still taking effect; new leg only

arguments.message: about 1100 m to go with over half the pod reserve: start a long finishing effort

arguments.condition: push_local_mps - push_along_mps < 0.03 and w_bal_pod_frac > 0.7 and shaft_power_w < cp_shaft_w and remaining_m > 1200
arguments.message: off the wash, below critical power, with most of the pod reserve left
under 400 m to go with pod reserve left: call the final sprint

text: no cue: back on a wash at 142 W shaft, below critical power, pod reserve 91 pct; keep the cheap wash and save the reserve for a long finish; boat-model alert ignored and watches moved to the pod reserve
no cue: through the turn and still on the wash at 142 W shaft with 91 pct pod reserve; holding the reserve for a long finish

arguments.text: Off the wash, lots left. Build to 2:44 pace and hold.

text: push to 2:44: off the wash at 144 W shaft, below critical power, with 91 pct pod reserve and 2.9 km left; earlier push without a target had no effect

arguments.text: Rate up two, same strong pull. You have plenty left.

text: rate up: two push cues left shaft power unchanged at 143 W, 25 W under the sustainable 168 W with 92 pct pod reserve and 2.1 km left

arguments.message: under 650 m to go with much of the pod reserve left: call the final sprint

text: no cue: rate-up cue under a minute ago; plan a long finishing effort from about 1100 m and the sprint call from 650 m

arguments.text: One kilometre left, tank is full. Build to 2:19 and hold.

text: push to 2:19: 1.1 km left with 92 pct pod reserve and shaft power 143 W against a sustainable 186 W; sprint call planned at 650 m
no cue: last cue 30 s ago; final leg begins, sprint call due at 650 m

arguments.text: Sprint now, empty the tank to the line!

text: finish: 637 m left with 91 pct pod reserve, enough for an all-out effort to the line
